amends: results/jenga/program_b_stage1_addendum_2.json training.seeds and G0_measurement.pass; adds descriptive G0 metrics
status: frozen before any G0 test measurement (requested by the user 2026-09-30)

change.seeds: G0 is run once with FIGNet* seed 1 against GNS seed 1. FIGNet* seeds 2 and 3 are not trained for now; they run only if the user asks later, and any such run is reported as a separate, later measurement.
change.pass: FIGNet* seed-1 position_error < GNS seed-1 position_error, AND FIGNet* seed-1 mean excess interpenetration < 1 mm (addendum 3)

descriptive_metrics.moving_windows: windows whose 'nothing moves' error (mean over steps and free objects of the true displacement from the start pose) exceeds 10 mm; report the count and both models' position error on them, beside the 'nothing moves' error
descriptive_metrics.gripper_contact_objects: free objects within 5 mm (coal convex distance) of any gripper part in any true frame of the window; report both models' mean position error on those (window, object) pairs, beside the 'nothing moves' error

change.note: The descriptive metrics do not gate. They were added after a validation-only look showed that the G0 position error is dominated by resting objects: GNS 4.8 mm against 5.6 mm for 'nothing moves' overall, but 16.0 against 23.5 mm on the 64 validation windows with real motion.

unchanged: test split, windows, the position-error and interpenetration definitions, final (400k) checkpoints
